2. Hazard(s) Identification

Not classified as a hazardous substance or mixture under 29 CFR 1910.1200. Signal word: None. No GHS hazard pictogram applies. Hazard statements: none. Precautionary statements: none required.

Hazards not otherwise classified: nuisance dust. Airborne powder may form a combustible dust cloud in confined spaces.

4. First-Aid Measures

Eyes: flush with water. Skin: wash with soap and water. Inhalation: move to fresh air. Ingestion: not applicable, food grade material.

5. Fire-Fighting Measures

Suitable media: water spray, dry chemical, carbon dioxide. Combustible dust; avoid raising a dust cloud during clean-up.
